journal_lines: Drowned rising from the water. Put it back.
Came up from the aquifer. Dealt with.
Stood at the edge of the pool a long time. So did I.
Trident through the dark water. Missed me by a paw.
Its hair moved when there was no current. Looked away after.
Came up at the lantern's edge. Sank without much fuss after.
A face you do not stare at. A face that does not stare back.
Waterlogged thing in the silt, holding something it did not need. I took the something.
Heard it breathing under the water. They are not supposed to.
Followed me along the shore for too long. Did not follow back.
